description.value: BBQ King Delight is a Cantonese-style roasted meat shop in Surrey specializing in Hong Kong BBQ classics: roasted duck, honey BBQ pork, soy sauce chicken, and crispy roasted pork, sold by weight or as rice bento boxes. Online ordering with a 15-minute pickup window makes it a fast, no-fuss stop. The menu skews heavily toward roasted and marinated meats, with canned soft drinks rounding out the offerings.
